name: CLI & Agent-First Onboarding
objective: Ship a vocky CLI so a user can sign up, log in, and configure credentials from Claude Code or Codex, with agent-readable help/guide docs so vocky is fully usable without visiting the website.

review.note: CLI feedback list/search truncate the record id to 8 chars but feedback show needs the full UUID, and no command surfaces a full feedback id — the documented list->show journey dead-ends. Fix in P5.F1, then re-review.
